ci_correction.correction: Translate the raw monotonic clock to epoch 2000 while preserving real elapsed deltas. Replace only the executor module time reference so subprocess wait and child sleep retain their real clocks. Allow two seconds of synthetic phase headroom with a four-second sleeping child.
ci_correction.failure: A test subtracted 1769.8 seconds from the arbitrary real monotonic epoch; fresh CI runners could therefore supply a nonpositive invocation origin, correctly rejected by execute before a child was spawned.
ci_correction.initial_ci_status: The original failed CI result remains evidence of the initial fixture defect; this local review does not assert that hosted CI has passed after the correction.
ci_correction.regression: Run real-child timeout assertions against both the normal raw clock and a synthetic near-zero raw epoch. Both require a positive invocation origin, a spawned and exited nonzero child, timeout=true and no verification child.
ci_correction.scope: Only tests/test_jolt_learning_executor_v2.py changed in the source closure. Production origin validation, deadlines, reserves, cleanup and admission remain byte-identical.
